Overview

A romantic week in Bali split between the green hills of Ubud and the beaches of the south. You stay in a private pool villa, enjoy a candlelit dinner and a couple spa, swing over the rice terraces and take a day trip to Nusa Penida's famous cliffs.

Tour highlights

  • Private pool villa stay in Ubud and Seminyak
  • Candlelit dinner on the beach
  • Balinese couple spa (60 minutes)
  • Kintamani volcano view and Tegallalang rice terraces
  • Nusa Penida island day trip
  • Uluwatu Temple sunset and Kecak dance
✈ Flights🛖 Villa Stay🍽 Candlelit Dinner💆 Spa

Day-by-day itinerary

Day 1 Arrive in Bali, transfer to Ubud

Fly from Mumbai to Denpasar. Meet our driver and transfer to your private pool villa in Ubud. Evening free to relax.

Day 2 Kintamani & Ubud tour

Visit Tegallalang rice terraces with a jungle swing, a coffee plantation, Kintamani for views of Mount Batur, Tirta Empul temple and Ubud Market.

  • Breakfast
Day 3 Couple spa & leisure

A slow day in Ubud with a 60-minute Balinese couple massage. Optional: Ubud Monkey Forest or a cooking class.

  • Breakfast
Day 4 Ubud to Seminyak via Tanah Lot

Check out and drive south. Stop at Ulun Danu Beratan lake temple and Tanah Lot for sunset. Check in at your villa in Seminyak.

  • Breakfast
Day 5 Nusa Penida day trip

Fast boat to Nusa Penida. Visit Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, Angel's Billabong and Crystal Bay. Return to Bali by evening.

  • Breakfast
  • Lunch
Day 6 Water sports & Uluwatu sunset

Morning water sports at Tanjung Benoa (banana boat, parasailing). Evening at Uluwatu Temple for sunset and the Kecak fire dance.

  • Breakfast
Day 7 Free day & candlelit dinner

Day at leisure for beach clubs or shopping. In the evening, a candlelit dinner on Jimbaran beach.

  • Breakfast
  • Dinner
Day 8 Depart for Mumbai

Check out and transfer to the airport for your flight home.

  • Breakfast

Frequently asked questions

Is this package priced per couple?

Yes, ₹85,000 is for two people sharing a villa, including flights. Prices change with travel dates and flight fares.

Can we change the villa or add more nights?

Yes. We can upgrade to a cliff-top or beachfront villa, or add nights in Nusa Dua or the Gili Islands.
